items.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer worth 17 times its bitcoin pile
items.summary: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.
